files.compose.yaml:
services:
  web:
    build:
      context: ./web
      dockerfile: web.Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
      - target: 443
        published: "8443"
        protocol: tcp
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O-", "http://localhost/health"]
      interval: 5s
  db:
    image: postgres:16
  dns:
    image: example/dns:1
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5353:53/udp"
